title: Page frame — wider colour worlds
question: Layout stays (page frame, short foot, floor rail, wallpaper window). This round is pure colour: five different worlds, not four teletext relatives. Pick one, or steer again.

options.label: Frame · Signal red
options.lineage: broadcast tally light — red on dark studio grey
options.thesis: Monochrome chrome, one broadcast red: quiet grey blocks, everything hot says it in red.
options.viewport: Near-black page; bone clock, red P100 and cues; grey blocks with bone names and white brand cubes; red outline marks the selection; chips stay physical-button colours at the foot.
options.risk: Monochrome blocks make apps harder to tell apart at a glance — the brand cubes carry all the identity.

options.label: Frame · Midnight teal
options.lineage: deep-ocean modern palettes — blue-green field with coral
options.thesis: The wallpaper window glows deep teal; coral numerals float on it like an instrument panel at sea.
options.viewport: Teal page; coral clock and cues; cream names on blue-slate blocks; coral outline on the selected block; micro lines pale steel; foot chips unchanged.
options.risk: The coloured ground competes with any wallpaper you put behind it — best treated AS the wallpaper.

options.label: Frame · Charcoal amber
options.lineage: valve-era instrument dials — amber on warm black
options.thesis: Warm black page, amber dial numerals — the room's lamp is the page itself.
options.viewport: Warm-black page; amber clock, P100 and cue; cream names on brown-charcoal blocks; amber outline on selection; micro lines warm grey.
options.risk: Warm cast everywhere can read dated if the amber is muddy rather than clean.

options.label: Frame · Paper ink
options.lineage: printed teletext listings on newsprint — inverted to paper stock
options.thesis: An editorial page on paper: ink-black blocks set on warm white, one print-red for selection.
options.viewport: Paper page; ink clock and indices; six ink-black blocks with paper-white names; red outline marks selection; grey micro lines; P110 cue in red.
options.risk: A full light page on an 85" panel is a lamp in a dark room — fine if the room is bright.

options.label: Frame · Candy pop
options.lineage: modern streaming-brand neons on true black
options.thesis: Black page, but the rail is contemporary colour — violet, neon green, cyan, magenta — teletext geometry with 2026 pigment.
options.viewport: True black page; white clock and cues; the six floor blocks in modern neons (red, violet, cyan, green, amber, pink) with white outline on selection; cubes unchanged; chips at foot.
options.risk: Neon blocks + brand cubes = two identity systems competing for the same glance.
